grader.scenario: Wi-Fi 6 laptop suffering throughput drops when Bluetooth headphones are active; resolved via 5 GHz SSID split
grader.notes: Good call where agent was technically thorough and resolved Bluetooth interference, failing only rapport for an insulting remark and active listening repeat in the final third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net wireless technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Olivia throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense pressure and high stakes of your product launch presentation today, Olivia...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased Bluetooth Wi-Fi interference issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for laptop model at turn 42 despite customer stating Dell XPS at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent split SSIDs, locked 5 GHz channel, prioritized QoS, and verified speed test with active Bluetooth audio.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you had read the basic wireless networking guidelines for Bluetooth peripherals, you would have separated your dual-band Wi-Fi channels months ago.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on Wi-Fi frequency and headphone usage.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested speed test on 5 GHz while streaming audio to headphones, verifying 380 Mbps download with zero buffering.
